data.why: The new behaviour is `dotsText` in src/render.ts, the `#dots` wiring in `render()` in src/main.ts, and the `#dots` span in index.html. The count itself is lowered by the existing `eatDot` in src/game.ts. CAP-4.7, 4.8 and 4.9 have no pointer to a source symbol. CAP-4.10 points only to `dotsText`, not to the `render()` wiring that shows the count. The canon would need pointers for `dotsText`, the `render()` wire-up and `eatDot` (the `dotsRemaining` decrement) under the right criteria. Source symbols can only be named through `// canon:` annotations on them.
